'''Chulein''' is a [[Seanchan]] ''[[morat'raken]]''.

== Activities ==
From her [[Raken]] she witnesses the massive explosion on the [[Kin]]'s farm when [[Elayne Trakand]] unravels her Gateway. She returns to [[Ebou Dar]] to report back.
